name: Motokano (kari) to Imakano to Boku
original_name: 元カノ(仮)と今カノと僕
source:
I currently have two girlfriends. But it's not like I'm cheating... We just haven't broken up yet.

On a peaceful afternoon spent with one of them, the intercom rang unexpectedly. That was the beginning of everything. Your choices will send the fates of the three of them from heaven to hell...?

A thrilling, dramatic story simulation of a love triangle. Full of relatable "things" about cheating that both men and women will find themselves relating to? A realistic adventure that's a bit of a horror story.


Translated and edited from Google Play description: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.jp.globalgear.motokano&hl=ja
